retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast graphic featuring a central white handprint mandala surrounded by a thick, orange typographic border on a dark charcoal background.
excludeWhen: a minimalist layout without borders is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition centered on a complex, radially symmetrical arrangement of white handprints that resemble a Rorschach inkblot or mandala. This central motif is enclosed by a heavy, rectangular border formed by bold, condensed orange typography that runs along all four edges, oriented to face the center.
coreVisualRelationships: Central white organic pattern against a dark void
Rigid geometric orange border framing fluid interior shapes
Radial symmetry in the center vs. four-way rotational symmetry in the border
High value contrast between white, orange, and charcoal
coreInvariants: Handprint motif as the primary building block
Tri-color palette of orange, white, and charcoal/black

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The handprint mandala occupies the central 60% of the square canvas.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dense cluster of handprints at the exact center of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright white center, radiates outward to the complex patterns, and is then contained by the vibrant orange border.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial dark charcoal space between the central motif and the outer border.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White for the intricate central pattern
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Orange for the framing typography
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation orange and high value white pop against a low value, matte background.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to three colors: Orange, White, and Charcoal/Black

characterSpecificRedesigns: The ampersand is stylized to fit the condensed width
Letters are slightly distressed to mimic screen-printing texture
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for all four border segments to maintain structural unity.
graphicDevices: Small handprint icons placed in the corners of the border

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and bold presence of the display text.
Provides the necessary verticality and blocky feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square dark charcoal canvas. In the center, create a radially symmetrical mandala pattern made of white ink-style handprints, resembling a Rorschach test. Leave a wide margin of empty space around the pattern.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a thick border of bold, extra-condensed orange uppercase text along all four edges. The text on the top should be upright, the right side rotated 90 degrees clockwise, the bottom 180 degrees, and the left 270 degrees, all facing inward.

verificationChecks: Is the central pattern perfectly symmetrical?
Does the orange text form a complete rectangular frame?
Is the background a consistent dark charcoal?
Are the handprints rendered in a high-contrast white ink style?

adjustableVariables: Complexity of the central handprint mandala
mustRedesign: Exact handprint configurations that match the original source

mustAchieve: Intricate organic symmetry in the center
avoid: Asymmetrical placement of the central motif

postGenerationChecks: Check that text is oriented correctly on all four sides
Ensure the white pattern does not touch the orange border
Verify the handprints look like ink stamps, not digital vectors
recipe.reuseFormula: Central [Subject] Mandala + [Color A] Typographic Border + [Color B] Background + [Color C] Subject Color
